links.outcome: Clinician-reported errors in AI-generated consultation notes, including hallucinations, and edit burden
links.effect: Context or meaning errors were most frequent; unsupported additions or hallucinations were uncommon; 26% of drafts required no edits; most reviews were <24 corrected words per minute.
links.quote: A qualitative analysis of clinician feedback showed that context or meaning errors were the most frequent, while unsupported additions or hallucinations were uncommon.

unlisted_practices: Comparing patient satisfaction between AI-scribe and usual-care consultations
Measuring initial transcription quality with Levenshtein distance as corrected words per minute

screen.reason: Empirical study of ambient AI documentation deployed in real primary care consultations, assessing workflow impact, transcription quality, clinician review time, and clinician and patient satisfaction.
